_: The games the dashboard shows, in tab order. Only public identifiers belong here: keys, tokens, and account numbers come from environment variables named <env_prefix>_* (see README.md). A platform's sync runs only while its status is live.

queries.community_players_total: select count(*) from runway.players where not house
queries.community_active_players_7d: select count(distinct p.id) from runway.players p where not p.house and (exists (select 1 from runway.ratings r where r.voter = p.id and r.at > now() - interval '7 days') or exists (select 1 from runway.entries e where e.player = p.id and e.updated_at > now() - interval '7 days'))
queries.community_weekly_entries: select count(*) from runway.entries e join runway.weeks w on w.id = e.week join runway.players p on p.id = e.player where w.state = 'live' and not p.house

queries.community_players_total: select count(*) from boards.players where not test
queries.community_active_players_7d: select count(distinct c.player) from boards.catches c join boards.players p on p.id = c.player where not p.test and c.at > now() - interval '7 days'
queries.community_weekly_entries: select count(*) from boards.entries e join boards.weeks w on w.id = e.week join boards.players p on p.id = e.player where w.state = 'open' and not p.test
